timeline.summary: Needle presents a black soul-drinking sword to Sadage as a gift for the Scion of Darkness.
timeline.quote: I bring you a gift for the Scion of Darkness.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: At the inn, Liliana tends Gideon's wound while the innkeeper says the Cabal has taken over the region.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: The innkeeper says the Church of Serra was routed by the Cabal in a battle days earlier.
timeline.quote: The Church of Serra came to help and there was a great battle only a few days ago, but the Cabal routed us.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Cabal undead knights attack the town at nightfall.
timeline.quote: She had barely started on the path through the ruins when she sensed the surge of undead malice.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana destroys a dozen knights with necromantic bolts.
timeline.quote: As the etchings on her skin flared violet, bolts shot out from her hands to strike a dozen black-armored knights.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: A panicked man reports a Cabal spy in the treasury of the Sarin Mercantile.
timeline.quote: A Cabal spy in the treasury of the Sarin Mercantile!

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira watches through her owl as a swordswoman fights Cabal agents on a warehouse roof.
timeline.quote: one woman with a sword fought half a dozen men wearing the concealing robes of desert nomads.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Shanna explains the Cabal agents wanted route maps to attack merchants.
timeline.quote: Cabal agents, trying to get the merchants' route maps

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Tiana and the angels find the town and the Great Machine destroyed by the Cabal.
timeline.quote: They circled around the plateau and Tiana saw what was left of the Great Machine.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 4" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Lyra attributes the destruction to the Cabal.
timeline.quote: This is the work of the Cabal.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 4" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Arvad says he fights the Cabal and sometimes feeds in battle.
timeline.quote: I fight the Cabal whenever I can.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 4" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana concludes a Cabal cleric used dementia magic.
timeline.quote: It's dementia magic all around, I'm afraid,

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Slimefoot climbs on deck, sees open water, and meets Karn, who tells it the ship is heading to Urborg to destroy Belzenlok in the Cabal's Stronghold.
timeline.quote: We are on our way to Urborg, to destroy the demon Belzenlok in the Stronghold of the Cabal.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 10" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Chandra admits Nissa's departure made her feel abandoned and says she is now ready to burn Belzenlok and the Cabal off the plane.
timeline.quote: I'm ready to burn Belzenlok and the Cabal right off this plane.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 10" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 May 2018.

timeline.summary: The time spell ends and the Stronghold fills with noise as Cabal cultists run to the defenses.
timeline.quote: Slowly, the silence around them filled like water poured into a bowl.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 11" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Whisper begins to kill the pit prisoners with black mist, and Chandra attacks her and her guards with fire.
timeline.quote: Whisper was going to kill the rest of the prisoners in the pit.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: The Cabal grows in strength under the Demonlord Belzenlok, posing new threats to Dominaria.
timeline.quote: as the cult of the Cabal grows in strength, now under the control of the Demonlord Belzenlok, Dominaria faces new threats
